topic: OpenAI launches Businesses in ChatGPT (beta, 10 Nov 2026): Business Hub profiles with mentions, clicks and discovery topics; US Business Agents
instagram_caption:
ChatGPT now lets businesses claim their own profile.

On 10 November, OpenAI launched Businesses in ChatGPT in beta. In the new Business Hub, verified businesses can update their details, add product feeds with prices and availability, and see aggregated insights: mentions, website clicks, profile views and the topics where their site gets cited. Business Agents, chat assistants that sit on your ChatGPT profile, are US-only for now. OpenAI says ChatGPT has 1.2 billion weekly users.

Why it matters: until now, brands could only guess how ChatGPT talked about them. This is the first data from OpenAI itself. Treat it carefully though: a click isn't a confirmed visit or sale, and insights only show above a minimum volume.

What to do this week:
1. Check whether your business is eligible in Business Hub and claim your profile early.
2. Clean up your product feed: prices, stock and descriptions, exactly as you'd want them quoted.
3. Tag ChatGPT referrals in your analytics so you can compare its click counts with real sessions.

You can't control what ChatGPT says about you. Now you can at least see it.

linkedin_text:
ChatGPT now lets businesses claim their own profile.

On 10 November, OpenAI launched Businesses in ChatGPT in beta. Through the new Business Hub, verified businesses can update their information, add product feeds with pricing and availability, and see aggregated insights: mentions, website clicks, profile views and discovery topics, the themes of conversations where their website is cited. Business Agents, which let people chat with a brand's own assistant from its ChatGPT profile, are limited to eligible US e-commerce and online service businesses for now. OpenAI says ChatGPT has 1.2 billion weekly users.

Our take: AI visibility has been measured with third-party prompt tracking and guesswork. This is the first first-party view from OpenAI. It is directional, not conclusive: recorded clicks do not confirm visits or conversions, and insights appear only above volume thresholds.

Three moves for this week:
1. Check eligibility in Business Hub and claim and verify your profile early.
2. Clean up your product feed so prices, stock and descriptions are exactly what you want quoted.
3. Tag ChatGPT referrals in your analytics and compare them with Business Hub click counts.

You can't control what ChatGPT says about you. Now you can at least see it.
